model.title: Model
model.description: The open-weight model the endpoint serves. Only models in Bitdepth's nightly run have a reference.

target.title: Target
target.description: Probe an OpenRouter endpoint (billed to Bitdepth's key, no key needed from you) or your own OpenAI-compatible server.

openrouter_endpoint.title: OpenRouter endpoint tag
openrouter_endpoint.description: The endpoint tag as OpenRouter lists it, for example deepinfra/fp8. Used when Target is OpenRouter.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Your OpenAI-compatible base URL, https only, ending before /chat/completions. For example https://inference.example.com/v1. Used when Target is My own endpoint.

model_name.title: Model name on your server
model_name.description: The model name your server expects in the request body, for example openai/gpt-oss-120b.

api_key.title: API key for your server
api_key.description: Sent only to your base URL, only for this run. Stored encrypted by Apify and never written to the output or the log.

declared_quant.title: Precision you serve (optional)
declared_quant.description: For the record only: bf16, fp8, fp4, int4 and so on. It does not change the grade.
